record.original_question: For compact flats F⊂Γ\G with Vol(F)<T and measures ν_T and barν_T formed by volume-weighted and normalized averages over those flats, do ν_T and barν_T converge to normalized Haar measure on Γ\G?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 24 (H. Oh) . Do the measures νT and ¯νT converge to the normalized Haar measure on Γ\G?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a connected semisimple real Lie group of real rank at least $2$, let $A\subset G$ be a maximal $\mathbb{R}$-split Cartan subgroup, and let $\Gamma\subset G$ be a torsion-free uniform lattice. A compact flat in $X:=\Gamma\backslash G$ is a closed orbit $F = \Gamma g A \subset X$ that is compact; each such $F$ carries a finite $A$-invariant Haar measure, and we denote by $\mathrm{Vol}(F)$ its volume and by $\mu_F$ the corresponding $A$-invariant probability measure supported on $F$.

For $T>0$, let $\mathcal{F}(T) := \{ F : F \text{ is a compact flat in } X \text{ with } \mathrm{Vol}(F) < T \}$, assumed finite for every $T$. Define the two families of finite Borel measures on $X$:
$$\nu_T := \sum_{F\in\mathcal{F}(T)} \mathrm{Vol}(F)\,\mu_F, \qquad \overline{\nu}_T := \frac{1}{\#\mathcal{F}(T)} \sum_{F\in\mathcal{F}(T)} \mu_F,$$
normalized so as to be probability measures (i.e.\ $\nu_T$ is divided by $\sum_{F\in\mathcal{F}(T)}\mathrm{Vol}(F)$).

Question: As $T\to\infty$, do $\nu_T$ and $\overline{\nu}_T$ converge in the weak-$*$ topology to the normalized $G$-invariant Haar probability measure $m_X$ on $X = \Gamma\backslash G$?
artifact.status_search_result: A direct resolution of this equidistribution question for averages over compact flats in higher-rank locally symmetric spaces does not appear in the literature; related work by Einsiedler–Lindenstrauss–Michel–Venkatesh and surveys by H. Oh treat partial cases (e.g., periodic torus orbits in arithmetic settings), but the general statement for both volume-weighted and uniform averages appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Harmonic analysis, ergodic theory and counting for thin groups (H. Oh)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys recent developments on counting and equidistribution for orbits in homogeneous spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Related equidistribution results by Oh; general compact-flat case not stated as resolved.
